title: 軌道道碴搗固整正~Ballast tamping and track alignment
focus: 道碴重排支承恢復與幾何保真~Ballast rearrangement support recovery and geometry fidelity
summary: 軌道道碴搗固整正以「道碴重排支承恢復與幾何保真」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。搗固把道碴重新配置到軌枕下方以恢復支承，起道後的幾何和重載後的幾何並非同一件事；必須把短期整正與長期沉陷追蹤連在一起。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops ballast rearrangement support recovery and geometry fidelity through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Tamping rearranges ballast beneath sleepers to restore support, but geometry immediately after lifting differs from geometry after traffic; short-term correction must therefore be connected with settlement monitoring. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把軌道道碴搗固整正放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。搗固把道碴重新配置到軌枕下方以恢復支承，起道後的幾何和重載後的幾何並非同一件事；必須把短期整正與長期沉陷追蹤連在一起。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Ballast tamping and track alignment in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Tamping rearranges ballast beneath sleepers to restore support, but geometry immediately after lifting differs from geometry after traffic; short-term correction must therefore be connected with settlement monitoring. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s；y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h。只把 sleepers 增加一個整數單位，y=1350 sleepers/h。模型邊界：每循環處理數固定且無停機；僅為理想連續產能；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.5 m2, gap=0.004 m；y=A*gap*1000=2 litre。只把 A 增加百分之十，y=2.2 litre。模型邊界：空隙以面積上的平均值代表；不描述局部懸空或顆粒排列；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s; y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h. Increasing only sleepers with an increase of one whole unit gives y=1350 sleepers/h. Boundary: Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.5 m2, gap=0.004 m; y=A*gap*1000=2 litre. Increasing only A with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 litre. Boundary: Gap is represented by its area-average value; local voids and particle arrangement are not resolved; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 搗固循環產能~Tamping cycle productivity
units.title: 搗固循環產能~Tamping cycle productivity
units.mechanism: 單循環處理數乘循環頻率只是理想產能。本模型把 sleepers 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 1350 sleepers/h。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。每循環處理數固定且無停機；僅為理想連續產能。使用實際循環與停機時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Units per cycle times cycle frequency gives ideal productivity only. In this model, sleepers is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 1350 sleepers/h. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only. Use actual cycles and downtime as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Increasing only sleepers with an increase of one whole unit gives y=1350 sleepers/h. Boundary: Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以實際循環與停機時間區分模型與觀察，先用合成循環起訖時間、每次軌枕數及停機原因帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「搗固循環產能」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use actual cycles and downtime to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic cycle start-end times, sleeper counts and downtime records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Tamping cycle productivity. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能。這個失效與「搗固循環產能」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查實際循環與停機時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity. This failure and a measurement bias in Tamping cycle productivity can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check actual cycles and downtime rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity.
units.practice: 重算「搗固循環產能」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出每循環處理數固定且無停機；僅為理想連續產能如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能造成偏離的合成觀察，以實際循環與停機時間說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Tamping cycle productivity, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity. Explain which evidence in actual cycles and downtime distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 軌枕底空隙量~Under-sleeper void volume
units.title: 軌枕底空隙量~Under-sleeper void volume
units.mechanism: 面積乘平均空隙描述需重新支承的體積量級。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 litre。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。空隙以面積上的平均值代表；不描述局部懸空或顆粒排列。使用支承接觸與空隙剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平均空隙會掩蓋局部懸空，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Area times average gap describes the volume scale requiring renewed support. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.2 litre. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Gap is represented by its area-average value; local voids and particle arrangement are not resolved. Use support contact and gap profile as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. An average gap hides local unsupported regions; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.anchor: 擠壓平均接觸壓~Mean squeeze contact pressure
units.title: 擠壓平均接觸壓~Mean squeeze contact pressure
units.mechanism: 平均壓力不能代表個別顆粒接觸點壓力。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 440 kPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。名義接觸面積已知且合力準靜態；不代表顆粒點接觸應力。使用力與接觸範圍作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；顆粒破碎會改變粒徑與長期支承，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Mean pressure does not represent individual grain-contact pressure. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 440 kPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Nominal area is known and resultant force quasistatic; particle point-contact stresses are not represented. Use force and contact extent as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Grain crushing changes grading and long-term support; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=8 kN, A=0.02 m2；y=F/A=400 kPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=440 kPa。模型邊界：名義接觸面積已知且合力準靜態；不代表顆粒點接觸應力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=8 kN, A=0.02 m2; y=F/A=400 kPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=440 kPa. Boundary: Nominal area is known and resultant force quasistatic; particle point-contact stresses are not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以力與接觸範圍區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型力計、接觸印跡面積及碎粒前後篩分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「擠壓平均接觸壓」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use force and contact extent to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.anchor: 模型擠壓作功~Model squeeze work
units.title: 模型擠壓作功~Model squeeze work
units.mechanism: 力位移積分描述機械輸入，並非全部能量都用於有效重排。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 17.6 J。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。力是行程內的代表平均值；只算外部機械作功。使用力位移迴圈作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；無效摩擦耗能會使高作功不代表高品質，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Force-displacement integration describes mechanical input, but not all energy produces useful rearrangement. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 17.6 J. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Force is the representative average over travel; only external mechanical work is included. Use force-displacement loops as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unproductive friction means high work does not prove quality; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=800 N, x=0.02 m；y=F*x=16 J。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=17.6 J。模型邊界：力是行程內的代表平均值；只算外部機械作功；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=800 N, x=0.02 m; y=F*x=16 J. units.title: 幾何殘差均方根~Geometry residual RMS
units.mechanism: 均方根保留誤差幅度，但仍須檢查局部峰值。本模型把 e1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.75214 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。三點等權且採同一基準；未量測區域及局部最大值另查。使用逐點殘差與位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~RMS retains error magnitude but local peaks still require inspection. In this model, e1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.75214 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Three equally weighted points share a datum; unmeasured regions and local maxima require separate checks. Use pointwise residuals and positions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One average quality score hides localized defects; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
